SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS june_units_sold,
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS june_pos_qty,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS june_audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status = 'on shelf'
     AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS june_on_shelf_audits,
  (SELECT MIN(audit_ts) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS first_audit,
  (SELECT MAX(audit_ts) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS last_audit;

SELECT 'shelf_audit' AS record_type, audit_ts::text AS ts, status AS detail
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'daily_sales', date::text, 'units_sold=' || units_sold || ', revenue_inr=' || revenue_inr
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', date::text, 'book_on_hand_close=' || book_on_hand_close
FROM store.inventory_book
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_count', count_ts::text, 'book_before=' || book_before || ', counted=' || counted || ', adjustment=' || adjustment || ', trigger=' || trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND count_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND count_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY ts, record_type;

SELECT audit_ts, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT SUM(units_sold) AS bags_sold
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_shelf_availability_pct
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';
